parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The synchronization or subscribe instance ID.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the DTS instance. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to reset the reverse synchronization task only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.
